quote: On February 15, 2019, Cresval Capital Corp. (TSXV: CRV) ("Cresval") announced that it has terminated its proposed plan of arrangement (the "Plan") with one of Riot Blockchain, Inc.'s ("Riot," the "Company," "We" or "Us") subsidiaries, 1172767 B. C. Ltd. (formerly Tess Inc.) ("Tess"), originally announced by Cresval on December 11, 2017.
